rows.label: tlk45310341_02_msg0001
rows.name:
The Hræsvelgr Mercenaries take
on jobs anywhere in Alst.

rows.label: tlk45310341_02_msg0002
rows.name:
My younger sister and I became
mercenaries because Vandham-san saved
us during a mission.

rows.label: tlk45310341_02_msg0003
rows.name:
I still haven't come close to
paying him back for that...

rows.label: tlk45310341_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Never dreamed he'd be gone
before I got the chance.

rows.label: tlk45310341_02_msg0005
rows.name:
Zuo-san and Yuu-san are working hard,
but I wonder what'll happen to us
from here...
